zh: 我弟弟和我哥哥一样高。
old_en: My brother is as tall as my older brother.
new_en: My younger brother is as tall as my older brother.

zh: 我女儿和她同桌一样高。
old_en: My daughter is as tall as her desk mate.
new_en: My daughter is as tall as her desk mate.

zh: 这件外套和那件大衣一样贵。
old_en: This coat is as expensive as that overcoat.
new_en: This coat is as expensive as that overcoat.

zh: 这台电脑和那台电脑一样便宜。
old_en: This computer is as cheap as that one.
new_en: This computer is as cheap as that one.

zh: 我妹妹和我朋友跑得一样快。
old_en: My sister runs as fast as my friend.
new_en: My sister runs as fast as my friend.

zh: 我同事和我骑车一样慢。
old_en: My colleague and I ride bikes as slowly as each other.
new_en: My colleague and I ride bikes at the same slow speed.

zh: 今天和昨天一样冷，要穿厚外套。
old_en: It's as cold today as it was yesterday, so you need to wear thick coats.
new_en: It is as cold today as it was yesterday, so wear a thick coat.

zh: 屋外和屋里一样冷，得多穿点。
old_en: It's as cold outside as it is inside, so you need to dress warmly.
new_en: It is as cold outside as inside, so dress warmly.

zh: 这家店的包子和那家的一样好吃。
old_en: The baozi from this shop taste as good as the ones from that shop.
new_en: The baozi here taste as good as the ones there.

zh: 这家店的面条和那家的一样好吃。
old_en: The noodles from this shop taste as good as the ones from that shop.
new_en: The noodles here taste as good as the ones there.

zh: 安全和速度一样重要。
old_en: Safety is just as important as speed.
new_en: Safety is just as important as speed.

zh: 健康和赚钱一样重要。
old_en: Health is just as important as making money.
new_en: Health is just as important as making money.

zh: 我姐姐和我一样忙，周末也要加班。
old_en: My sister is as busy as me, she has to work overtime even on weekends.
new_en: My sister is as busy as I am and works overtime on weekends too.

zh: 这两双鞋一样便宜，质量也差不多。
old_en: These two pairs of shoes are as cheap as each other, and the quality is also similar.
new_en: These two pairs of shoes are equally cheap and have similar quality.

zh: 这两道题一样简单，我很快就做完了。
old_en: The two questions were as easy as each other, and I finished them quickly.
new_en: The two questions were equally simple, so I finished them quickly.

zh: 这两份表格一样简单，十分钟就能填完。
old_en: These two forms are as simple as each other, and they only take ten minutes to fill out.
new_en: These two forms are equally simple and take only ten minutes to fill out.

zh: 这两个背包一样便宜，都在打折。
old_en: These two backpacks are as cheap as each other, and they are both on sale.
new_en: These two backpacks are equally cheap because they are both on sale.

zh: 从我家到地铁站和到超市一样远。
old_en: The subway station is as far from my home as the supermarket is.
new_en: It is as far from my home to the subway station as to the supermarket.

zh: 从学校到公园和到图书馆一样近。
old_en: The park is as close to the school as the library is.
new_en: The park is as close to the school as the library is.

zh: 我同事和我一样忙，午饭都没时间吃。
old_en: My colleague is as busy as I am and has no time for lunch.
new_en: My colleague is as busy as I am and has no time for lunch.
